newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA, UPM INVIGORATE HELSINKI, BUT JITTERS REMAIN.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA, UPM INVIGORATE HELSINKI, BUT JITTERS REMAIN.

text.p: Shares ended higher on
Wednesday, with the HEX index tacking on more than a percent
after moderate trading with Nokia and UPM standing out, but
doubts remained about the strength of the trend, brokers said.
"We'll live in uncertainty until the Fed's next meeting,"
one broker said, referring to the May FOMC meeting which may
produce a move in key rates.
Nokia A closed 3.90 markka higher at 308.90 after touching
309.00 in fair 161 million markka volume, helped by recent
strength in U.S. tech stocks and in the dollar, brokers said.
Forestries outperformed: UPM was lively, up 5.00 to 116.00.
"The strong dollar explains UPM's gains," one broker said,
but another said investors were buying in ahead of the April 11
ex-dividend date.
Tamro rose 0.40 markka to 33.00 on several block trades
carried out at buy-order prices, brokers said.
Neste ended flat at 126.00 markka, recoverying from early
declines as it went ex dividend.
Valmet rose 2.50 markka to 89.50, also helped by the strong
dollar, brokers said.
